item.title: Park Ji-won: Targeting Park Geun-hye and MB, "Squid and Goby... Yoon Seok-youl Might Join Them" (박지원, 박근혜·MB 겨냥 “꼴뚜기·망둥이…윤석열도 함께 뛸라”)
item.description:
Park Ji-won, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, took a jab at former Presidents Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye, who have been campaigning for the People Power Party candidates in the June 3 local elections, saying, "Squid and goby are all running across every corner of South Korea," and added, "At this rate, it looks like we'll see a world where Yoon Seok-youl from prison also joins the race." (박지원 더불어민주당 의원이 6·3 지방선거 국민의힘 후보 지원 유세에 나선 이명박·박근혜 전 대통령을 겨냥해 “꼴뚜기 망둥이 다 대한민국 방방곡곡을 뛴다”며 “이러다 감옥의 윤석열도 함께 뛰는 세상이 될 것 같다”고 꼬집었다.)

On the 27th, Rep. Park said on Facebook, "Following Park Geun-hye's aggressive moves, is MB heading to Busan too?" He added, "Is this the proper conduct for two people—one impeached and removed from office, and the other who should be in prison for corruption and abuse of power?" He continued, "The people are afraid. We must stay sharp and judge them." (박 의원은 27일 페이스북에서 “박근혜의 광폭 행보에 이어 MB도 부산행?”이라며 이같이 말했다. 박 의원은 “탄핵으로 파면된 전직 대통령, 국정농단과 비리로 감옥에 있어야 할 두 사람이 할 짓인가”라며 “국민이 무섭다. 정신 바짝 차리고 심판해야 한다”고 덧붙였다.)

This criticism was aimed at both former President Park, who was removed from office and convicted to 22 years in prison, a 180 billion won fine, and a 3.5 billion won forfeiture for charges including allowing a confidante to meddle in state affairs and receiving special activity funds from the National Intelligence Service, and former President Lee, who was convicted to 17 years in prison, a 2 billion won fine, and a 5.78 billion won forfeiture for embezzling company funds from auto parts maker DAS and receiving bribes and US litigation costs from Samsung Group. Former President Park was granted a special pardon by former President Moon Jae-in in December 2021, and former President Lee by former President Yoon Seok-youl in December 2022. (대통령직에서 파면당한 뒤 비선 실세 국정농단 사건과 국가정보원 특수활동비 상납 등의 혐의로 징역 22년과 벌금 180억원, 추징금 35억원이 확정됐던 박 전 대통령과 자동차 부품업체 ‘다스’의 회삿돈을 횡령하고 삼성그룹으로부터 미국 소송비와 뇌물을 받은 혐의로 징역 17년과 벌금 20억원, 추징금 57억8000만원이 확정됐던 이 전 대통령을 묶어서 비판한 것이다. 박 전 대통령은 2021년 12월 문재인 전 대통령에 의해, 이 전 대통령은 2022년 12월 윤 전 대통령에 의해 특별사면됐다.)

Former President Park is fulfilling a schedule equivalent to a 'election committee chairperson' for the People Power Party. After visiting Daegu on the 23rd, and Chungcheong and Daejeon on the 25th, she visited Yeongnam regions including Jinju, Ulsan, and Busan on the 27th. She is scheduled to visit Gangwon on the 28th. Former President Lee Myung-bak also met with People Power Party Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon on the 15th. (박 전 대통령은 국민의힘 ‘선거대책위원장급’ 일정을 소화하고 있다. 23일 대구, 25일 충청과 대전을 방문한 데 이어 27일에는 경남 진주와 울산, 부산 등 영남을 찾았다. 28일에는 강원을 찾을 예정이다. 이명박 전 대통령도 지난 15일 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보를 만난 바 있다.)

Within the 'Yoon Again' faction, there is a growing desire for former President Yoon's return. On the 27th, far-right YouTuber Ko Seong-guk appeared on lawyer Kang Yong-seok's YouTube broadcast and said, "There's one more card left for the free conservative camp," adding, "A message from President Yoon Seok-youl in prison will come out, it must come out, that's what I think." Ko also said, "I believe President Yoon will ultimately issue a message from prison saying, 'Let's go together, we need to unite as a single front.' And it's only right that he does so." (‘윤 어게인’ 세력에서는 윤 전 대통령 등판을 바라는 분위기다. 극우 유튜버 고성국씨는 27일 강용석 변호사의 유튜브 방송에 출연해 “자유우파 진영에 카드가 하나 더 남아 있다”며 “윤석열 대통령의 옥중 메시지가 나온다, 나와야 된다, 그렇게 생각한다”고 말했다. 고씨는 “윤 대통령이 옥중 메시지로 최종적으로는 ‘함께 가자, 단일 대오로 가야 된다’, 이런 메시지를 낼 것이라고 본다. 그리고 내야 마땅한다고 생각한다”고도 했다.)

Ko further stated, "The significance of former President Park Geun-hye's campaigning is that it ultimately unites the free conservative camp, which was scattered and in a state of loss. If President Yoon's message from prison comes out, it will also target not the left or centrist citizens, but our free conservative citizens," adding, "If the free conservative citizens build a united front like that and all go out to vote, the election will be unconditionally won." (고씨는 “박근혜 대통령의 유세가 굉장히 의미 있는 것은 결국 흩어졌던, 그리고 상실감에 빠졌던 자유우파를 결속시키는 거 아닌가. 윤 대통령의 옥중 메시지가 나온다면 그것 또한 타깃은 좌파나 중도 국민이 아니라 우리 자유우파 국민”이라며 “자유우파 국민들이 그런 식으로 단일 대오를 구축하고 다들 투표장에 나가면 선거는 무조건 이긴다”고 말하기도 했다.)

Jeon Gwang-jun reporter light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party: "TK Advantage... Seoul, Gangwon, Daejeon, South Chungcheong, Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam Competitive" (국힘 “TK 우세…서울·강원·대전·충남·부울경 경합”)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) has assessed the situation for the June 3 local elections, identifying Daegu and North Gyeongsang as advantageous regions, while deeming Seoul, Gangwon, Daejeon, South Chungcheong, Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang as battleground regions. (국민의힘은 6·3 지방선거 판세와 관련해 대구·경북을 우세지역으로, 서울·강원·대전·충남·부산·울산·경남을 경합 지역으로 판단하고 있다고 밝혔다.)

Jung Hee-yong, head of the PPP's election campaign headquarters, held a press briefing at the party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, on the morning of the 28th, a day before early voting, stating, "Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk's official election campaign, which began with campaign support rallies in Daejeon and South Chungcheong, focused on targeting public sentiment in the central region and spreading that momentum nationwide, which was a key strategy in the early and mid-stages of the election." Jung added, "We analyze that the passionate campaigning by candidates, combined with recent support from former President Park Geun-hye, has consolidated the support base, leading to tight races in many areas." The remaining regions not mentioned (Gyeonggi, Incheon, North Chungcheong, Sejong, North Jeolla, South Jeolla-Gwangju, Jeju) appear to be assessed as disadvantageous. <<> Regarding the parliamentary by-elections, Jung stated that Dalseong in Daegu is considered an advantageous region, while Ulsan's Nam-gu Gap and Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang in South Chungcheong are viewed as competitive but advantageous regions. (정희용 국민의힘 선거대책본부장은 사전 투표를 하루 앞둔 28일 오전 서울 여의도 당사에서 기자간담회를 열어 “대전·충남 지원 유세로 시작된 장동혁 대표의 공식 선거운동은 중원을 중심으로 민심을 공략하고 그 흐름을 전국적으로 확산시키고자 했던 선거 초중반 전략이 주요했다”며 이렇게 말했다. 정 본부장은 “후보들의 열정적인 선거 운동과 최근 박근혜 전 대통령님의 지원이 더해져 지지층이 결집하면서 곳곳에서 초접전 양상이 나타나는 것으로 분석하고 있다”고 했다. 언급하지 않은 나머지(경기·인천·충북·세종·전북·전남광주·제주) 지역은 열세 지역으로 판단하는 것으로 보인다.)

Additionally, regarding the possibility of a candidate unification in Busan's Buk-gu Gap, a parliamentary by-election district, between PPP candidate Park Min-sik and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, Jung drew a line, saying, "Since Candidate Park Min-sik has clearly stated his position on unification, the central party respects the candidate's stance." On questions about the electoral situation in this region, he said, "Yesterday, former President Park visited Busan and earnestly appealed to give Candidate Park Min-sik a chance to work," adding, "I believe that yesterday's event has quickly laid the groundwork for closing the gap, and if we continue campaigning with local election candidates until the end, we think we can achieve meaningful results." (국회의원 재보궐선거와 관련해서는 대구 달성을 우세 지역으로, 울산 남갑과 충남 공주·부여·청양을 경합 우세 지역으로 판단했다고 정 본부장은 밝혔다.)

The PPP also encouraged participation in early voting. Jung said, "We will thoroughly monitor and inspect the entire process of early voting to ensure there are no concerns," and urged, "Please cast your valuable vote for the PPP candidates with confidence." The leadership decided to split between regular voting and early voting, but Chairman Jang chose to participate in regular voting. Previously, in March of last year, Jang proposed a bill to amend the Public Official Election Act, which aimed to abolish the early voting system. (또 국회의원 보궐선거 지역구인 부산 북갑에서 박민식 국민의힘 후보와 한동훈 무소속 후보 사이 단일화 가능성에 대해서는 “박민식 후보께서 단일화 관련해서 입장을 분명하게 밝히기 때문에 중앙당에선 당 후보 입장을 존중한다”고 선을 그었다. 그는 이 지역 판세에 대한 질문에는 “어제 박 전 대통령이 부산을 방문해 박민식 후보에게 일할 기회를 달라고 간곡히 호소했다”며 “어제를 계기로 빠르게 추격 발판이 마련될 것으로 생각하고 끝까지 지방선거 후보들과 함께 선거운동을 진행하면 유의미한 성과를 거둘 수 있을 것으로 생각한다”고 했다.)

Jang Na-rae Reporter wing@hani.co.kr Jo Hee-yeon Reporter choh@hani.co.kr (국민의힘은 사전투표 참여도 독려했다. 정 본부장은 “사전투표 대해선 걱정하시는 일 없도록 전 과정을 꼼꼼히 살피고 점검하겠다”며 “안심하고 국민의힘 후보에게 소중한 한 표를 보내달라”고 했다. 지도부는 본투표와 사전투표를 나눠서 하기로 했으나, 장 대표는 본투표에 참여하기로 했다. 앞서 장 대표는 지난해 3월 사전투표제 폐지를 골자로 한 공직선거법 개정안을 대표 발의했다.)

item.title: Outgoing National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik: "Best achievement was lifting martial law, regret not achieving constitutional amendment" (‘퇴임’ 우원식 국회의장 “가장 잘한 건 계엄 해제, 개헌 못 이뤄 아쉬워”)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, one day before his retirement on the 28th, cited "lifting the emergency martial law" as his best achievement over the past two years, and "constitutional amendment" as his biggest regret for not being accomplished. He remained tight-lipped about the speculation of running for party leader at the August party convention after returning to the Democratic Party. (우원식 국회의장이 퇴임을 하루 앞둔 28일 지난 2년 동안 가장 잘한 일로 “비상계엄 해제”를, 이루지 못해 가장 아쉬운 일로는 “개헌”을 꼽았다. 더불어민주당 복당 뒤 8월 전당대회 당대표 출마설에 대해서는 말을 아꼈다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly on this day, one day before stepping down as the speaker for the first half of the 22nd National Assembly, Woo cited "protecting democracy and restoring the constitutional order in the face of the December 3 emergency martial law" as his primary accomplishment during his term. He said, "In a time of national crisis, the National Assembly led the restoration of constitutional order, and trust in the National Assembly has increased both domestically and internationally. It was a meaningful change in the history of the National Assembly and a great source of pride for me." (우 의장은 22대 국회 전반기 국회의장 퇴임을 하루 앞둔 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 임기 첫번째 성과로 “12·3 비상계엄에 맞서 민주주의를 수호하고 헌정 질서를 회복한 것”을 꼽았다. 그는 “국가적 위기 상황에서 국회가 헌정 질서 회복을 주도했고 대내외적으로 국회에 대한 신뢰도가 높아졌다. 국회 역사에서도 의미 있는 변화였고 저로서도 큰 보람이었다”고 했다.)

Woo stated, "Not only the lifting of martial law but also the subsequent early presidential election was very challenging. With many unprecedented events, we faced gaps in constitutional interpretation every time and dealt with them through a process of careful and intense judgment." He added, "It was later confirmed through the Constitutional Court's decisions that our judgments were largely flawless and correct. That is a satisfying point." As an example, he cited the "impeachment quorum controversy" during the impeachment of Acting President and Prime Minister Han Duck-soo. Regarding the dispute over whether the quorum for impeaching the acting president should be 200 seats (the quorum for impeaching a president) or 151 seats (the quorum for impeaching a prime minister), he explained, "We interpreted this as not impeaching the function but the position. Acting President Han is a prime minister performing the duties of the president. Thus, it is the general quorum (151 seats). This was an interpretation not explicitly stated in the constitution." <<> As his biggest regret during his term, he cited "failing to amend the constitution to fundamentally prevent the National Assembly from blocking illegal emergency martial law." He said, "If the second half of the National Assembly cannot achieve a constitutional amendment, it will be a huge regret in my life." He added, "We revised the National Referendum Act to remove procedural obstacles, and public consensus for a step-by-step constitutional amendment has widened. I hope the second half of the National Assembly will form a special committee on constitutional amendment and see results." <<> Woo was cautious about his plans after retirement. Regarding rumors of being appointed as Prime Minister, he indirectly denied it by saying, "Serving as National Assembly Speaker made me love the Assembly even more." However, on the speculation of running for party leader at the Democratic Party's convention in August, he did not give a clear stance, only saying, "I will do my best for the democracy of our country and the socially disadvantaged." Asked whether he would support the June 3 local elections after returning to the Democratic Party, he replied, "I will play the role needed as a party member." <<> According to the National Assembly Act, Woo, currently an independent, will step down as speaker at midnight on the 29th and return to the Democratic Party. To Cho Jung-sik, the Democratic Party's candidate for speaker of the second half of the 22nd National Assembly, who will be elected at a plenary session on the 5th of next month, he advised, "You must not make partisan choices. You should think about what benefits the people and democracy." He added, "I hope you will devise better ways to handle livelihood-related bills. Please continue the National Assembly's social dialogue body well." <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (우 의장은 “계엄 해제뿐 아니라 그 후 조기 대선까지가 아주 험난했다. 전례 없는 일들이 많다 보니 헌법 해석의 공백에 부닥칠 때마다 신중하고 치열한 판단의 과정을 거쳐 대처했다”며 “대체로 큰 흠결 없이 틀리지 않은 판단을 했다는 게 이후 헌법재판 결과를 통해서도 확인됐다. 뿌듯한 점”이라고 말했다. 그 예시로는 한덕수 전 대통령 권한대행 겸 국무총리 탄핵 때의 ‘탄핵 정족수 논쟁’을 들었다. 대통령 권한대행의 탄핵 의결 정족수를 대통령 탄핵 정족수인 200석으로 할지, 국무총리 탄핵 정족수인 151석으로 할 건지 논란이 있던 상황에서 “‘이건 직무를 탄핵하는 게 아니라 직위를 탄핵하는 거다. 한 권한대행은 대통령 권한을 대행하는 직무를 하는 국무총리다. 그렇기에 일반 의결 정족수(151석)다’ 이렇게 헌법에 나와 있지 않은 해석을 우리가 했다”는 것이다.)

item.title: Minister Cho Requests Singapore's Foreign Minister, Who Visited North Korea, to "Pay Attention to Conditions for Dialogue" (조현 장관, 북 다녀온 싱가포르 외교장관에 “대화 여건 관심 당부”)
item.description:
Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul met with Singaporean Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan on the 28th and asked for attention and support in creating conditions for dialogue with North Korea. (조현 외교부 장관은 28일 비비안 발라크리쉬난 싱가포르 외교장관과 회담에서 북한과의 대화 여건을 조성하는 데 관심과 지원을 당부했다.)

Minister Balakrishnan is visiting South Korea after stops in China and North Korea, and met with North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui in Pyongyang on the 26th. Minister Cho listened to Minister Balakrishnan's impressions of his North Korea visit and requested attention and support from Singapore and the ASEAN level in fostering conditions for dialogue with North Korea. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs reported that Minister Balakrishnan expressed sympathy and responded by saying the two sides should communicate closely for peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula. ( 발라크리쉬난 장관은 중국, 북한을 거쳐 한국을 방문 중이며, 지난 26일 평양에서 최선희 북한 외무상과 회담했다. 조 장관은 발라크리쉬난 장관의 방북 소감을 듣고 북한과의 대화 여건을 조성하는 데 싱가포르를 비롯한 아세안(ASEAN) 차원의 관심과 지원을 당부했다. 발라크리쉬난 장관은 공감을 표하고 한반도 평화와 안정을 위해 양측이 긴밀히 소통해 나가자고 답했다고 외교부가 전했다.)

The two ministers exchanged opinions on key bilateral issues, the region, and international developments of mutual concern. Minister Cho welcomed Minister Balakrishnan's first official bilateral visit to South Korea since taking office in 2015 and assessed that the strategic partnership between the two countries is deepening through active high-level exchanges, including President Lee Jae-myung's reciprocal visit four months after Singaporean Prime Minister Lawrence Wong's official visit to South Korea in November last year. Minister Balakrishnan emphasized that South Korea and Singapore are friendly nations sharing core values such as free trade and multilateralism, and expressed hope for expanding and deepening mutually beneficial cooperation in various fields, including trade, investment, high-tech, and new growth sectors. ( 두 장관은 양국 주요 현안과 지역, 국제정세 등 공동 관심사에 대해 의견을 교환했다. 조 장관은 발라크리쉬난 장관이 2015년 취임 이후 양자 차원의 첫 공식 방한을 한 것을 환영하고, 지난해 11월 싱가포르 로렌스 웡 총리의 공식방한에 이어 4개월 만에 이재명 대통령의 답방이 이루어지는 등 활발한 고위급 교류를 통해 양국 간 전략적 동반자 관계가 한층 심화되고 있다고 평가했다. 발라크리쉬난 장관은 한국과 싱가포르가 자유무역과 다자주의 등 핵심 가치를 공유하는 우방국임을 강조하면서, 교역·투자 및 첨단·신성장 등 다양한 분야에서 양국 간 호혜적 협력을 더욱 확대, 심화해 나가기를 기대한다고 말했다.)

The two ministers shared assessments of the recent situation in the Middle East and agreed that peace in the region and the freedom and security of navigation in international waterways, including the Strait of Hormuz, are crucial to the security and economy of both countries, which are trading nations. They decided to continue close communication and cooperation on this matter. ( 양국 장관은 최근 중동 정세에 관한 평가를 공유하고, 중동 지역의 평화와 호르무즈 해협 등 국제 통항로의 자유로운 항행과 안전 보장이 통상 국가인 양국의 안보와 경제에도 매우 중요하다는 점에 공감하면서, 이와 관련하여 양국간 긴밀한 소통과 협력을 지속해 나가기로 했다.)

Minister Balakrishnan is also scheduled to meet with Unification Minister Kim Young-ho on the same day to discuss the situation on the Korean Peninsula. Singapore, which emphasizes a neutral diplomatic stance, maintains smooth diplomatic relations with both South and North Korea and played a mediating role by providing the venue for the first North Korea-U.S. summit in June 2018 between then-U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un. ( 발라크리쉬난 장관은 이날 정동영 통일부 장관과도 만나 한반도 정세 등을 논의한다. 중립적 외교 기조를 강조하는 싱가포르는 남북한 모두와 원만한 외교 관계를 유지하고 있고, 2018년 6월 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 1차 북미 정상회담을 할 때 장소를 제공하는 등 중재 역할을 했다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr ( 박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: On Seosomun Overpass Collapse and GTX Rebar Omission, "Responsibilities Must Be Strictly Enforced" (이 대통령, 서소문 고가 붕괴·GTX 철근 누락에 “책임 엄정히 물어야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 28th, referring to the recent collapse of the Seosomun overpass demolition site and the case of omitted rebar in the GTX-A Samsung Station, "Relevant authorities must swiftly get to the bottom of these matters, and based on the results, strictly hold accountable those responsible, regardless of their position." (이재명 대통령이 28일 최근 발생한 서소문 고가차도 철거 현장 붕괴 사고, 수도권광역급행철도(GTX)-에이(A) 삼성역 철근 누락 사태 등을 거론하며 “관계기관이 신속하게 진상 규명하고, 그 결과에 따라 지위고하를 막론하고 엄정하게 책임을 물어야 한다”고 말했다.)

At a senior secretary meeting held at the Blue House, President Lee said, "In corners of our society, there still persists a bad practice of prioritizing money over safety and efficiency over safety." He added, "The collapse at the Seosomun overpass demolition site the day before yesterday, and the rebar omission issue at Samsung Station for the GTX—these may stem from such ills, and a thorough investigation is necessary." <<> "These cases are particularly serious because they involve the public sector, which above all should be leading in ensuring public safety," President Lee continued. "Money cannot be more precious than lives. We must remember that safety is the most efficient investment." <<> President Lee also noted that today marks the 10th anniversary of the Guro Station disaster. "Today marks the 10th anniversary of the Guro Station disaster, where a young worker working alone on the platform was struck and killed by a train," he said. "Thanks to public attention and on-site efforts, industrial accident fatalities have significantly decreased in the first quarter of this year, but many deaths are still occurring." <<> Seo Young-ji, reporter yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 수석보좌관회의에서 “우리 사회 일각에서는 안전보다 돈, 안전보다는 효율을 중시하는 그런 못된 관행이 여전하다”며 “그저께 발생한 서소문 고가차도 철거 현장 사고, 삼성역 수도권광역급행철도 철근 누락 문제 역시 이러한 병폐에서 비롯된 것 아닌지 철저한 조사가 필요하다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Local election early voting rate: 20% → 21% → what about this time?… Ruling and opposition parties urge voter base consolidation (지방선거 사전투표율 20%→21%→이번엔?…여야, 지지층 결집 호소)
item.description:
Early voting for the June 3 local elections and National Assembly by-elections will take place over two days starting on the 29th. Both the ruling and opposition parties are encouraging early voting and rallying their support bases. (6·3 지방선거와 국회의원 재보궐선거 사전투표가 29일부터 이틀간 실시된다. 여야 모두 사전투표를 독려하며 지지층 결집에 나섰다.)

Cho Seung-rae, Secretary-General of the Democratic Party of Korea, said at a press briefing on the 28th, “Early voting begins tomorrow. Representative Chung Cheong-rae is encouraging voting through media appearances, briefings, and campaign rallies in Seoul.” Representative Chung said at rallies in Gangdong, Gwangjin, and Mapo in Seoul, “They say the conservatives are consolidating, so we must unite even more tightly,” adding, “There is only one secret to winning this election. Please choose a Democratic Party candidate who will work in sync with President Lee Jae-myung to ensure stable state affairs.” <<> Jeong Hee-yong, Secretary-General of the People Power Party, also stated at a press briefing, “The passionate campaigning by our candidates, combined with former President Park Geun-hye’s support, has consolidated our support base, leading to close contests in many areas,” and added, “We will carefully monitor early voting to ensure there are no concerns. Please confidently cast your vote for the People Power Party candidate.” He said, “Citizens who believe the arrogance of the Lee Jae-myung administration must be judged will go to the polls,” and noted, “A high early voting rate is always advantageous.” <<> In recent local elections, the early voting rate has been just over 20%. In 2018, when the Democratic Party won by a landslide, it was 20.14%, and four years ago, when the People Power Party won by a landslide, it was 20.62%. The overall voter turnout dropped sharply from 60.2% in 2018 to 50.9% in 2022, but the early voting rate remained similar. <<> Early voting rates in local elections are generally lower compared to presidential or general elections. In the 2022 presidential election, where Yoon Suk Yeol and Lee Jae-myung fiercely competed, the early voting rate hit a record high of 36.93%, while in the 2024 presidential election it was tallied at 34.74%. In the 2020 and 2024 general elections, the rates were 26.69% and 31.28%, respectively. <<> This June 3 election, held a year after the early presidential election triggered by the martial law crisis and impeachment, resembles the situation of the 2018 local elections. Additionally, National Assembly by-elections in 14 districts, described as a “mini general election,” are expected to impact the early voting rate. <<> During the two days of early voting, voters can cast their ballots at any early voting station nationwide, regardless of their registered address, from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. The locations of polling stations can be checked on the website of the National Election Commission and on portal sites. <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr ( 조승래 더불어민주당 사무총장은 28일 기자간담회에서 “내일부터 사전투표가 시작된다. 정청래 대표가 미디어 출연과 간담회, 서울 유세 등을 통해 투표를 독려하고 있다”고 말했다. 정 대표는 이날 서울 강동·광진·마포 유세에서 “보수가 결집한다는데 우리는 더 똘똘 뭉쳐야 한다”며 “이번 선거의 승리 비법은 딱 한 가지다. 이재명 대통령이 국정을 안정적으로 이끌 수 있도록 대통령과 손발 맞춰 일할 민주당 후보를 뽑아달라”고 말했다. )
